Critical hits with Surprise Strike are more damaging than most skills.<RGB=#00ff00>

1879098760.desc: Examines the weaknesses and strengths of certain creatures.\n\nWhen used in combat, your target will suffer reduced resistances, attack speed, and Critical Chance.

1879099272.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the cowbell.

1879153288.name: Javelin of Deadly Force - Fire
1879153288.desc:
With preparation, some Wardens can throw their javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.

For every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

With the appropriate Assailment traits, this javelin will apply the Marked and Diminished Target debuffs to any targets hit.
This skill is not influenced by modifiers to Max Range.

1879190664.name: Steed of Night
1879190664.desc: Black as the night, this unique looking pony has 250 Morale and is as fast as a reputation mount. The pony has the added benefit of not knocking you off immediately when critically hit by an attacker.

1879198344.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Onyx Sabre-cat)
1879198344.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879218312.name: Improved Chord of Salvation
1879218312.desc: Instantly heals an ally's Morale, applying a small heal to their Fellowship.

conditionalEffects.description: Chord of Salvation will grant your target 1% of their Max Morale for every nearby ally.

1879241992.name: Clash of Arms
1879241992.desc: Using superior tactics, you deal very little damage to a target but assess the enemy so well that you gain a significant advantage over your foe.

1879244424.name: Resounding Challenge
1879244424.desc: Your challenge echoes in the ears of your foes.

conditionalEffects.description: The Resounding Challenge Gambit deals instant bonus damage instead of applying damage over time.

1879260040.name: Quick Shot: Flaming Arrow
1879260040.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879262984.name: Goading Strike
1879262984.desc: You strike, not necessarily to deal damage, but to goad your foe into attacking you. You will be ready for their next attack and your strategy increases the morale of you and your allies.

1879263240.name: Rolling Thunder
1879263240.desc: Your steed rides towards your enemies like a force of nature, with thunderous hooves and lightning in its eyes. Your target flees from you for a short time.

1879263624.name: Lay Trap
1879263624.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Applies a 10s Fear effect to the first enemy who triggers the trap.</rgb>

1879270920.name: Lissuin Pony
1879270920.desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.

1879319176.name: Vicious Claws: Roar
1879319176.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nCosts less Wrath.

1879331464.name: Steed of Ethuil
1879331464.desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.

1879387912.name: Guide to Hultvís
1879387912.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Hultvís.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879430280.name: Muster at Leitstáth
1879430280.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Leitstáth

1879457544.name: Deflection
1879457544.desc: Use your shield to redirect your enemy's attention.

conditionalEffects.description: The Deflection Gambit increases, rather than reduces, your threat to any enemies hit.

1879500424.name: Glorfindel's Aid
1879500424.desc:
Call upon Glorfindel to empower his Elf-stone to purge the essence of the void seeping into Middle-earth.
<rgb=#00FF00>Destroys active blisters around you.</rgb>

To use this skill, you must be near Glorfindel.

1879506824.name: Rallying Cry
1879506824.desc: A rallying cry invigourates you and nearby allies.

1879508616.name: Dusky Grodbog Queen
1879508616.desc: Summons a dusky grodbog queen to accompany you on your adventures.

1879516680.name: Drop Blue Mushroom
1879516680.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879525256.name: Sack of Petals
1879525256.desc: A sack of flower petals. There appear to be enough to share with others.
